tasks.label: Check diff
tasks.command: git status --short && git diff -- index.js routes/producto.routes.js

tasks.label: Check git diff exact files
tasks.command: cmd /c "git --no-pager status --short && echo. && git --no-pager diff -- index.js routes/producto.routes.js"

tasks.label: gitstatus2
tasks.command: git --no-pager status --short; echo .; git --no-pager diff -- index.js routes/producto.routes.js

tasks.label: Commit tracked fixes
tasks.command: git add index.js routes/producto.routes.js; git commit -m "Fix static UI serving and stock-low route" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>"

tasks.label: commit2
tasks.command: git add index.js routes/producto.routes.js; git commit -m "Fix static UI serving and stock-low route" -m 'Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>'

tasks.label: Verify repository
tasks.command: git remote -v; git rev-parse --show-toplevel; git status --short; git branch --show-current

tasks.label: Check repository branch
tasks.command: git status -sb; git --no-pager log -1 --format="%h %s"; git config --get-regexp "^remote\..*\.(url|fetch)$"

tasks.label: Inspect git staging
tasks.command: git status --short; git --no-pager diff --cached --name-only; git remote -v

tasks.label: Add GitHub origin
tasks.command: git remote add origin https://github.com/IvacacheG/BackendInventario.git; git remote -v

tasks.label: Verify pushed repository
tasks.command: git status --short; git --no-pager log -1 --oneline; git branch -vv
